title: Remove empty Todo (Legacy) board state
description: The live Kanbus board still renders an empty `Todo (Legacy)` column. No project issue currently uses the `todo` status. Remove only the unused `todo` status definition and its workflow/transition-label references from the project configuration and the matching console board fixture. Preserve active statuses and semantic categories. Add or update focused validation as needed. Do not migrate issues because the column count is zero. Leave the completed work in Review with a visible summary and test evidence; do not merge or close it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Removed the unused todo status from .kanbus.yml and apps/console/tests/fixtures/kanbus.board-columns.yml, including its default workflow transitions, status definition, and transition labels. Preserved all active statuses and semantic categories; no issue migration was needed. Validation: both YAML files parse successfully, each has 7 active statuses, and default workflow/transition-label references resolve without todo. Full board validation was attempted with the current Rust CLI but remains blocked by pre-existing unrelated issue-data integrity errors.
